_about: Every user-facing text of Baby Log in English and Simplified Chinese, keyed for the native iOS app (the frozen web app in docs/ and static/ does not read this file). English is quoted exactly as the web app shows it today; the planned native features (bath, photos, outing checklist, reminders, Siri) are translated up front. Placeholders are {name} and are identical in both languages; a key ending in .one / .other is one string with CLDR plural variants (Chinese does not inflect, so both forms match). Dates, times, numbers and units are formatted by the system locale, never by these strings — weekday and month names, clock times, decimal separators and the °C sign are not here.
